notes.title: 12 August Playtest Update
notes.notes:
[h1]GAMESCOM PRELIMINARY BUILD[/h1]
Build No. #844

[h2]Warriors of Nova Thera Playtest is Now Live![/h2]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]
Our latest build of Warriors of Nova Thera is now live and ready for playtesting. The team have made some major updates to both gameplay and visuals, and we're looking forward to your reactions and feedback on them.
We recommend using a controller for the best experience.

Your feedback is crucial as we fine-tune the game. Please be sure to fill out the feedback form after your playthrough. The link to it can be found can be found in our discord announcement. 

[b]What We’re Looking For:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Feedback on the new tutorial and room progression changes.
    [*]Your thoughts on new features like Draconic Caches, Gold currency, and the updated combat, shop, and fountain rooms.
    [*]Reactions to the new Borg Passive Ability, enhanced boss fights difficulty and enjoyability, and the new enemy, Cherrybomb and it's new behaviour.
    [*]Opinions on the updated UI, BGM, SFX, and VFX.
[/list]

Do take note that the skill tree & rune management is locked for balancing at the demo at Gamescom, tutorial pop-ups haven't been updated yet with latest control schemes and and mention of competition isn't referring to the playtest game, it's just for the Gamescom demo.


[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
    [*][b]Goloidon Fight Crash:[/b] The game may crash when starting the Goloidon boss fight. This is not a guaranteed occurrence, so players may need to attempt the fight again on a new run.
    [*][b]Tutorial Room Loop:[/b] After clearing the tutorial room with Buggleberry, players may get stuck in a loop when trying to move on to the next room. The workaround is to close and relaunch the game. The tutorial will be skipped automatically on the next run.
    [*][b]Tutorial Room Checklist Bug:[/b] Players may get stuck on the last objective of breaking the enemy's stance bar. The workaround to this is to replay the tutorial room as it is not a guaranteed occurrence.
    [*][b]Character Description Error:[/b] Grailon has an incorrect description on the character selection screen.
[/list]

notes.title: 23rd May Playtest Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]KEY UPDATES: BUILD NO.#480[/h1]

[h2]Camera Updates[/h2]
[b]In-game camera rotation:[/b]
[list]
    [*][b]Mouse & Keyboard:[/b] Press and hold the middle mouse button.
    [*][b]Game controller:[/b] Use the right joystick.
[/list]

[b]Camera distance:[/b] Pulls back in Boss rooms to address prior navigational issues.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]New Boss[/b] :skull_and_crossbones:: Introducing Goloidon (Goloid EV2).
    [*][b]New Attack VFX:[/b] Included for various attacks.
    [*][b]SFX:[/b] First pass on new sound effects.
        [list]
            [*]Tweaked Bruizer sound effects and timing.
        [/list]
[/list]

[h2]Mini-map Updates[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Room exit icon:[/b] Now sits on the rim of the mini-map for easier visibility.
    [*][b]Enemy indicators:[/b] Disappear when an enemy is defeated (immediately, rather than after a delay).
    [*][b]Player indicator:[/b] Changed to a compass arrow.
[/list]

[h2]Enemy Behavior[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Elite version of enemies:[/b] Can no longer be interrupted.
[/list]

[h2]Survival Rooms Update[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Timer:[/b] Changed to a countdown timer.
    [*][b]Wall UVs:[/b] Fixed.
    [*][b]Enemy Waves:[/b] Balanced.
    [*][b]New Rooms:[/b] Two new small rooms added, large room removed.
    [*][b]Rewards Room:[/b] Updated map to indicate the location of the treasure box.
[/list]

[h1]Minor Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Gameplay Fixes:[/b] Various tile collision fixes for smoother gameplay.
    [*][b]Mouse & Keyboard:[/b] Cursor is used to aim skills, updated for Fireball and Lava Claws.
    [*][b]Game controller:[/b] Cursor disappears when the controller is in use.
    [*][b]Game HUD UI Update:[/b] Character skill controls update based on hardware choice (Mouse & Keyboard or Game Controller).
    [*][b]Game controller keybinding:[/b] Can now be changed in settings (limited to single buttons for now).
    [*][b]Keyboard keybindings:[/b] Already changeable.
    [*][b]Skill Tree Page Update:[/b] Shows VFX on unlocked skill icons, unlocked skill tree nodes, and equipped rune slot.
    [*][b]Summary Screen:[/b] “Continue” button can now be interacted with when using a game controller.
    [*][b]Pop-up Warning:[/b] Appears if you attempt to exit the game while in a game run.
[/list]
```
